node.statement: By node 1.3.1, lem-stage1-maurer-cartan-trivialization applies and supplies the fiberwise linear bundle isomorphism omega_U:T_U calU -> icalH, omega_U(Z)=(L_U^{-1}Z)^par. Consequently dim T_U calU=dim icalH. For Phi_g(B)=L_U(B+Dg_U(0)B), the inclusion from the preceding step makes omega_U(Phi_g(B)) defined, and the displayed formula gives omega_U(Phi_g(B))=(B+Dg_U(0)B)^par=B because Dg_U(0)B is Hermitian. Thus Phi_g is injective, so its image has dimension dim icalH. The inclusion between finite-dimensional spaces of equal dimension is equality: T_U calU=im L_U(I+Dg_U(0)).
